knowledge-domain.summary: A Cleric for whom learning is worship: a scholar of lore, secrets and the workings of the mind.

Blessings of Knowledge.summary: Proficiency with one set of Artisan's Tools, and proficiency plus Expertise in two of Arcana, History, Nature and Religion.

choices.note: you also gain Expertise in both

Knowledge Domain Spells.summary: Always prepared: Detect Magic, Command, Identify, Comprehend Languages, Mind Spike and Detect Thoughts at Cleric 3; Dispel Magic, Nondetection and Tongues at 5; Arcane Eye, Banishment and Confusion at 7; Legend Lore, Scrying and Synaptic Static at 9.

Mind Magic.summary: Magic action: spend a Channel Divinity use to cast a prepared Divination spell from your domain list with no slot and no Material components.

Unfettered Mind.summary: Telepathy 60 ft, reaching up to WIS modifier creatures at once (min 1). Gain INT save proficiency, or another save you lack if you already have it.

Divine Foreknowledge.summary: Bonus Action: Advantage on D20 Tests for 1 hour. Once per Long Rest, or restore it by spending a level 6+ slot.
